Yes, the employer can likely enforce the covenant. Under the majority rule, continued at-will employment is sufficient consideration for a covenant signed mid-employment, and the employer in fact kept the employee on for two more years. The injunction still depends on the covenant being reasonable in duration, scope, and geography, and a minority of jurisdictions require something more than continued employment. The team note's "no new consideration needed" rule isn't the general common-law rule, so I'm not relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 72
